prerequisites: Good command of at least one object-oriented language (e.g. Java, Kotlin, C ++, Python)
Basic knowledge of networked and distributed application programming techniques

learning_outcomes.text: Design and implement distributed applications involving mobile devices of various kinds: from the user interface of interactive devices, to application logic, from connection to cloud services, to sensor control, up to packaging and the deployment of mobile applications on stores available online.

syllabus_topics: Pervasive computing: definitions, application scenarios, enabling technologies.
Main operating systems in the mobile and embedded fields. Introduction to Android.
Version control and continuous integration, devops for mobile, wearable and embedded systems.
Design of graphic interfaces on mobile platforms.
Interprocess communication in android: Intents and filters.
Microservices and Services integration issues. (annotated examples for the Java platform).
Management of resources (cpu, network, peripherals), sensors (gps, inertial sensors, specific sensors) and software services (telephony, mail, etc.)
assessment_rules: The exam consists of the presentation of the agreed and developed project work, followed by an oral interview to ascertain knowledge of the topics covered in the lectures. The material produced in the project work will be discussed at the examination. Grading is based on a final score (Voto Finale).
bibliography: Android Programming, Bill Phillips, Chris Stewart, et. to the.
Operating Systems Foundations with Linux on the Raspberry Pi
Kotlin Programming by Example, Iyanu Adelekan
Building Microservices: Designing Fine-Grained Systems by Sam Newman
RESTful Web Services, Leonard Richardson, Sam Ruby
Restlet in Action, Jerome Louvel, et. al.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica (Computer Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
